title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether It Is Valid for a Debtor to Mortgage All Its Property to One Creditor When Having Multiple Creditors

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Official Reply on Whether It Is Valid for a Debtor, Having Multiple Creditors, to Mortgage All Its Property
to One of the Creditors
Fa Fu [1994] No. 2
Higher People's Court of Shandong Province:
We have received your Petition on Whether It Is Valid for a Debtor, Having Multiple Creditors, to Mortgage All Its Property to One of the Creditors. Upon study, we reply as follows:
Where a debtor has multiple creditors and mortgages all its property to one of the creditors, thereby losing the ability to perform its other debts and harming the legitimate rights and interests of the other creditors, according to Articles 4 and 5 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the mortgage agreement shall be deemed invalid.
March 26, 1994
